local_application.compact_gate: Exact A*W^(star L)=0 admission checks every mixed top tensor term using polynomial-size iterated spans and explicit native failure witnesses.
local_application.saturation: Odd powers saturate the disjoint signed projective-block span, certainly by2k-1 and often earlier. The general stable coding structure and regularity bound are known.
local_application.refinement: Saturated admission implies an explicit disjoint-support kernel refinement containing the original frame; no source sampler or decoder follows.
local_application.reference_source_law: For a fixed frame independent of uniform A, conditional admission given AW=0 costs3^(-n*(power_rank-k)). This formula is disabled for adaptive frames.
local_application.positive_escape: Unsaturated source-adapted low-Schur-growth spaces, shorter native disjoint dependencies and useful entangled packets remain open.

proof_obligations_for_next_candidate.PO-CONSTRUCTION: Efficiently find the proposed frames under the actual IID native source, not a planted low-label pattern or unjustified fixed-frame probability estimate.
proof_obligations_for_next_candidate.PO-POWER: Certify the required whole mixed higher-Schur gate, report saturation and supply exact failure witnesses when rejected.
proof_obligations_for_next_candidate.PO-RETENTION: Show a total throughput improvement over the explicit disjoint kernel refinement and known source-recursive baselines.
proof_obligations_for_next_candidate.PO-VISIBILITY: Preserve informative phase order and recover all original secret digits; top-degree admission alone is not enough.
proof_obligations_for_next_candidate.PO-SOURCE: Charge intermediate acquisition, adaptive selection, all physical outcomes, correlations, source consumption and any filtering.
proof_obligations_for_next_candidate.PO-DECODER: Supply a full decoder under actual state access and compare known varying-matrix phase algorithms, quantum sieves and legal classical inference.
proof_obligations_for_next_candidate.PO-REVIEW: Independent mathematical review and novelty audit before a CandidateRecord is accepted.

falsifiers: A compact span basis contains a nonzero weighted native mixed derivative.
The frame saturates and its claimed overlap gain disappears under the explicit disjoint refinement.
Low-Schur-growth structure is planted or only available through expensive source conditioning.
A fixed independent-frame probability is applied after adaptively choosing the native frame.
Admitted outputs lose target phase order, coefficient rank or growing-depth throughput.
next_experiment: Find or rule out efficiently constructible unsaturated native weighted-Schur frames with informative growing-depth outputs; compare against disjoint dependencies and an implicit full-source receiver.
